objective: Repair cursor pagination while preserving ordering, limits, and response immutability.
rationale: Four small source modules and one exact pagination defect make this a negative control for native search and direct reading.
acceptanceInvariants: The initial API page is requested without a cursor.
All cursor pages are fetched once in order until nextCursor is absent.
maxPages rejects an unfinished cursor chain.
Returned items and API page arrays are not mutated.
